description: The only shop on Kiln Lane with nothing in its window, because it has no window. The whole street face is one panel of municipal green paint with a door in the middle of it, and across the top, gold on black, shadowed, done properly by somebody who charged for it: PHOTO FINISH. A double-sided clock stands out over the pavement on a wrought bracket and keeps better time than anything else on this street. Above the parapet a long lit box runs the width of the building with figures crawling across it, and there are men out here at two in the morning reading it.
name: Photo Finish
